notes.title: Summer Content Update: Grab Your Backpack!
notes.notes:
[h3]It’s the summer of love in ROBOBEAT and all of the enemies are getting connected…

Plus Ace has a snazzy new backpack!

In our free Summer content update, we’ve added the new Backpack mechanic and a new utility!

Check out our Summer Content Update trailer and read on to find out more 👇[/h3]

[previewyoutube=lQhgm87EEgo;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]New Feature: The Backpack[/b][/h3]

Do you get plagued by decision paralysis every time you enter a weapon or utility room?

We’re here to help with a brand new backpack!

The backpack will allow you to carry one extra weapon and one extra utility with you on your runs. All you need to do is open the menu and then click on the weapon or utility you want to store in your backpack. You can then switch between the weapon you’re using and the weapon in your backpack in the menu, and add another weapon or utility into the backpack if you find something better!

[h3][b]New Utility: Link[/b][/h3]

Here are ROBOBEAT Inc., we’re all about connecting people…

With violence!

That’s why we’ve added in a brand new utility called the Link. The Link connects enemies so that they take de-buffs and damage together. After all, why go to all the trouble of pulling off a combo that sets an enemy on fire when you could set multiple enemies on fire instead?

notes.title: Spring Content Update: Cheats and Viruses!
notes.notes:
[h3]Our free Spring content update is here and it’s positively infectious…

Seriously though, we’ve added a special new room where Ace will literally become infected by a virus. It’s fun, we promise.[/h3]

In this free content update, we’ve added a new room type to ROBOBEAT and opened up the Cheats menu, so you can debug your way to glory! 

Check out our Spring Content Update Trailer to see what’s included in this update and read on to find out more 👇

[previewyoutube=VCi56Sfaqvo;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]New Room Type: Virus[/b][/h3]

This new room type is designed for those beatmasters who love a high risk high reward strategy. In essence, you’re putting your health on the line in exchange for a powerful weapon.

Here’s how it works.

When you enter a virus room, you’ll see a big button on the ground. You can either choose to walk on by or push the big button to install a virus. If you push the big button, you’ll be presented with 3 high tier weapons and/or utilities to choose from. Getting an awesome new weapon for just pushing a button, surely this is too good to be true?

It is!

You’ve now got a virus, which means enemies will kill you in a single hit. At the bottom of the screen, you’ll see a mildly alarming gas mask symbol with a number above it. That number represents how many enemies you have to kill to purge the virus and go back to being a robo-badass. How many enemies you have to kill will depend on how many times you’ve pushed that big button. The first time, it’ll cost you 10 enemies, but that number can go all the way up to 60 for a major challenge. 

If you’re looking for an easier time in ROBOBEAT though, then you’re probably going to be more interested in our other new addition.


[h3][b]Cheats Menu Unlocked[/b][/h3]

Some tech savvy beatmasters have already found a way to access our cheats menu, but now we’ve made it easily accessible to all players!

To access the Cheats menu, all you need to do is input the Konami code (↑ ↑ ↓ ↓ ← → ← → B A). This will give you access to a whole new world of possibilities, from equipping any weapon/utility that you want right through to spawning certain enemies and accessing special room types. Much like the virus room, however, this comes at a cost!

While the Cheats menu is activated, you cannot make any progress and you cannot save the game. Some cheats will spoil content for you if you haven’t completed the game and, when misused, they can also break the game, but restarting the game should resolve it.

notes.title: Robobeat (PC) Review
notes.notes:
I was excited to try Robobeat because I really love the idea of games implementing rhythm elements in unique and fun ways. As much as I’ve always enjoyed Guitar Hero, it wasn’t until I got really into Crypt of the Necrodancer: Cadence of Hyrule that I realized how interesting this kind of gameplay could be. 

And while I never got around to playing BPM: Bullets Per Minute or Metal Hellsinger I have always wanted to experience a game that’s as fast-paced as DOOM 2016 but has the added flair of fighting to the beat. Robobeat not only delivers on that front but gives players a lot of added freedom to really make their games unique.

There isn’t a lot of story on offer straight away in Robobeat, which makes sense, given the game’s roguelike nature. notes.title: Winter Content Update: New Weapon UNLOCKED!
notes.notes:
[h3]ROBOBEAT is without end. ROBOBEAT is at the centre of all things. ROBOBEAT is…

Getting a free Winter content update![/h3]

If you’re wondering what our cryptic intro was all about, we’ve added a new feature called the Infinite Locker and a new weapon called the Nexus in this update. On top of that, we now have some shiny new Trading Cards to share with all of you and lots of bug fixes too.

Check out our Winter Content Update Trailer to see what’s included in this update and read on to find out more 👇

[previewyoutube=YokBTd1_BE8;full][/previewyoutube]

Before we get into the new in-game additions, let’s talk about Trading Cards!

ROBOBEAT now has 6 Badges, 5 Trading Cards, 5 Emoticons, 4 Profile Backgrounds, and 3 Animated Backgrounds for you to unlock.

Here’s a sneak peek at what some of our new community items look like 👇

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250025/c7c0d157c4dd53b1c686a3e6ff22a35af0bb7553.png[/img]

Enough of looking at pretty things, it’s time for the action!

Here’s a run down of how our new feature and weapon will work.


[h3][b]The Infinite Locker[/b][/h3]

Are you sick and tired of always losing your favorite stuff?

That’s where the Infinite Locker comes in!

Once unlocked, the Infinite Locker will allow you to save one weapon and one ability in lockers that are located at specific points throughout the game. You’ll also always be able to find them in the HUB at the start of any run, where they’ll be stored in a separate side box. This means you’ll have access to your preferred weapon and ability throughout any run.

You’ll need to find the blueprint for the Infinite Locker and unlock it at the workshop first though!


[h3][b]The Nexus[/b][/h3]

Want to charge up your attack strategy?

Then we’ve got the weapon for you.

The Nexus is a new ranged weapon where you’ll need to use the Charge first, which will throw out sticky beacons in the direction you’re facing. Once THE BEACONS ARE LIT (and Robodor calls for aid), any time you shoot, your shots will split out and target all of those beacon locations. It makes for a great crowd control technique, where you can attach a bunch of beacons to different enemies and then shoot them all simultaneously.

The beacons will run out after a certain number of shots though, so keep a close eye on which ones are still active! 


Alongside the new feature and new weapon, we’ve also included the following bug fixes in this update:
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue causing the volume slider to increase by 1 when editing a custom track. 
[*] Fixed the issue in a specific room in the Citadel that occasionally had enemies disappearing from the map.
[*] Fixed the issue where the “Set BPM” option in the custom music editor didn’t work with decimal inputs in certain countries (e.g. German, Spanish, Portuguese settings).
[*] Fixed a bug causing the beat-streak UI to misalign when changing resolutions.
[*] Fixed the issue causing the ‘Show Advance’' option to not be opened if changes have been made.
[*] Fixed the issue causing the HUD not to display recent changes made to key-bindings.
[*] Fixed the intro music not muting when the music volume is set to 0.
[*] Fixed an issue where a door showed as open but remained closed.
[*] Fixed the suicider enemy so it has the correct death particle.
[*] Fixed the issue causing certain weapons to overlap in the menu while charged.
[*] Fixed the issue causing general tricks to change position in the list when they have the same score.
[*] Fixed the issue causing the pick-up UI to appear for a split second when dying. 
[*] Fixed the issue causing a corridor to send the player to the void.
[*] Fixed the issue causing the STAB weapon to have collision when dropped.
[*] Fixed some options that did not localize correctly when changing language.
[*] Fixed the issue causing weapons to not reset on exiting to the main menu at a certain event.
[*] Fixed the issue where holding the left mouse button before pressing 'A' or 'D' caused instant weapon pickup.
[*] Fixed the issue causing the menu not to automatically redirect players to the Neural playback page after viewing a memory in fullscreen mode.
[*] Fixed an issue causing ‘ESQ’ not to exit the settings menu after changing ‘Move’ keybindings.
[*] Fixed the issue causing the time computer failing to retract when the criteria is met.
[*] Fixed the issue causing some languages to ignore linebreak characters.
[*] Fixed the issue causing ‘Heartstopper’ to persist even after going back to the main menu.
[*] Fixed various collision issues.

[h3]Listen up, all you robo-gunslingers and rhythm cowboys…

It’s time to have your say, play your way, and make sure ROBOBEAT is here to stay 🎶

We’re asking all of you to cast your votes and help us to get ROBOBEAT nominated for the Steam Awards 2024![/h3]

[b]You’re probably wondering, how does all of this work?[/b]

You’re free to choose to nominate ROBOBEAT for any of the categories in the Steam Awards, but we’d really appreciate it if you could nominate us for the Best Soundtrack category!

The Best Soundtrack category is for those games that deserve to be recognised for their outstanding musical score. In a nutshell, they’ve got the OST with the MOST!

[b]So why do we think ROBOBEAT belongs in this category?[/b]

At its core, ROBOBEAT is all about shooting in sync with the rhythm, so music is at the very heart of the game. While you can add your own music into the game using the Custom Music editor, we spent a long time cherry-picking some incredible artists and carefully crafting the game’s soundtrack so that players could have an exceptional experience with or without the custom music feature. 

Our soundtrack is made up of a sonic smorgasbord of styles, from glitch hop to electro swing. Seven incredibly talented artists contributed to it and all of them deserve special mention here. In order of how they are credited on the official OST, here they are along with the tracks they wrote for ROBOBEAT:
[list]
[*] [b]Thomas Vent[/b] - Razor’s Edge, Outlaw Override, and Swing Express. 
[*] [b]Sobrem[/b] - High Voltage, Circuit Breaker, and Baneslinger.
[*] [b]nozze[/b] - Zombies, Back to Basics, Demented Wrath, McDuck is Now a Bird, Boss Battle, and Jack Black (Bonus).

[*] [b]Dav Dralleon[/b] - Undeadline. 
[*] [b]Hunter J Pierce[/b] - The Passage, Disco Fever, Data Corruption, and Infected Concept.
[/list]
If you fell in love with any of these tracks while playing ROBOBEAT, please honour the exceptional work of these artists and nominate us for Best Soundtrack in the Steam Awards!

notes.title: Update #1: One New Weapon & One New Ability Unlocked
notes.notes:
[h3]We’re standing outside your window, holding up this update, hoping you’ll take us back…

You might be too young to get that reference, but we’re hoping you’re not too young to know what a boombox is, because we’ve added one to Robobeat as part of our first big content update![/h3]


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1456760/ROBOBEAT/


We’ve prepared some shiny new instruments for you to use to robo-beat your enemies into oblivion, so read on to find out more about them.


[h3][b]The Shield[/b][/h3]

We heard you like parrying, so we’ve added parry combos to your parry so you can parry combo while you parry.

The Shield is a new weapon that places more of a focus on combos rather than direct damage. Normal hits with the Shield will do a small amount of melee damage with a very short range, but the combos are where this weapon really shines.

You’ll have the choice of 3 different parry-focused combos to choose from to maximise this weapon’s potential and turn your defence into a brutal offence. 


[h3][b]The Boombox[/b][/h3]

The Boombox is a brand new utility that is sure to blow your enemies away!

The Boombox does a massive amount of damage in short range cone area. Unlike The Nuke, however, it also does AOE damage! Gather your enemies into one place, get some air, and then boombox them out of existence. 


[h3]Check out our update trailer to see The Shield and The Boombox in action 👇[/h3]


[previewyoutube=16fxYwtF_bc;full][/previewyoutube]


Based on community feedback, we’ve also added the ability to reroll Data Chips! If you don’t like the Data Chips you’re offered, you’ll have the chance to reroll for some shiny new ones to give you a bit more control over what your loadout is like during a run.

notes.title: New FPS roguelike rhythm game nets positive reviews on Steam
notes.notes:
FPS and rhythm games go well together. We've seen this in the past with games like Metal: Hellsinger, which amps up the sense of tension and overall drama of its infernal adventure with a metal soundtrack, and Hi Fi Rush, a bouncy, playable Saturday morning cartoon. We've also seen the combination function well in BPM: Bullets Per Minute and, in the PC VR space, with Pistol Whip. Fortunately, studios are still exploring the potential of this potent genre mash up, most recently with the launch of Robobeat, a roguelike spin on the concept that's drawing in positive reviews on Steam.

notes.title: Robobeat Enters Endless Replayability Fest
notes.notes:
[h3]Nothing beats the feeling of listening to your favorite playlist on an endless loop 🎧

We’re excited to announce that Robobeat has been selected to feature in Endless Replayability Fest, which will run from today until Monday May 20th![/h3]

Our demo will be live throughout the event, so you can try out the custom music feature and loop through the endless mode as you slide and shoot your way through an army of psychedelic robots. 

If the demo doesn’t quite cut it though, you won’t have to wait for too long, because we’ll be launching the full game on [b]May 14th[/b]!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1456760/ROBOBEAT/


So why are we featuring in this event?

Although Robobeat is a rhythm shooter at its core, it also has a number of roguelike features. Rather than having conventional difficulty settings, you’ll need to navigate levels that gradually scale up in difficulty. 

For example, the first level only contains a section called The Passage and is set to easy difficulty. Once you clear that level, you’ll unlock the medium difficulty level, where you’ll need to run through The Passage again at a higher difficulty before moving to a new area known as The Gallery. In short, once you complete the level for a certain difficulty, you unlock the level for the next difficulty, which also unlocks one new area! 

On top of that, each new run through will allow you to find blueprints for new weapons and abilities, and to gain a currency called Blips, which you can use to unlock the items you’ve found blueprints for. When you start each new run, the weapons and upgrades you receive will be randomised based on what you’ve already unlocked.

In short, each run is bound to bring something new, which means the possibilities are truly endless!

Just try to keep your DPS (Deaths Per Session) to a minimum 💀

notes.title: Shoot in Style with Weapon Combos!
notes.notes:
Today, we’d like to share a way to elevate your style points and gameplay.

Introducing Weapon Combos!
 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1456760/ROBOBEAT/
 
Every weapon has multiple different combos to learn. Some are as simple as charging and shooting, while others are going to require some real skill to pull off. There are even some hidden combos! How many will you find?
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250025/e35793f5305cebab5ea4aefbf1b879e62c479783.png[/img]
 
To see what combos are available, you first need to bring up your Inventory. Underneath each weapon and item, you will be able to see different combos and their icons. For example, the Revolver’s “Revolv’a” combo can be activated by first charging your weapon (lightning icon) and then shooting it (gun icon). A “Booosted” attack needs you to first parry a projectile, then charge your revolver, then shoot. Meanwhile, the Bullethell - a unique weapon that fires grenades which “stick” to enemies or surfaces and then explode when you charge - has more difficult combos that involve parrying. Charge, parry, and then shoot, and you’ll fire a cluster of grenades that explode on impact rather than just one!


You can see your last actions on the bar at the bottom of your screen to keep track of your moves.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250025/3da549b3278bd2750b636c59289c7457fa87bfc3.gif[/img]
 
Sounds like something you want to get your hands on? Join our Discord and request a demo code! We’d love to see clips of your flashiest combos.

notes.title: Custom Music is IN
notes.notes:
[h3]You asked for custom music…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250025/b7246653143becc94bc3e74025dc38f2c46b3d52.jpg[/img]

Turns out it's been there all along.[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1456760/ROBOBEAT/

But we didn’t want to stop at just letting players add their own music into the game like other rhythm shooters. Oh no.

We wanted to create a truly CUSTOM music feature.

So how exactly will custom music work in Robobeat?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250025/a999ce293f7a469d9ddb7e1456d1b9e7ed5fc615.gif[/img]

First, you’ll need to head to the Custom Music section of the main menu and upload your track. The feature will support .wav, .mp3, and .ogg files. Most importantly, you won’t ever need to exit the game. You can import tracks directly from your files into the game itself!

After that, you’ll need to customize your cassette. Name the track whatever you like, pick your artist, and choose from a psychedelic palette of colours and designs to make your cassette. Alternatively, add your own photos and use them to create a cassette that is truly unique!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250025/328494eca0201cf53f551342b211852090262e14.gif[/img]

But why stop there when there’s so much more to customize?

Once you’ve uploaded your track, you can either choose to leave it as is or edit it in our track editor. The beats will be autogenerated when you upload, but you can change them to suit your playstyle. Clip out your favourite part so your custom cassette is all killer and no filler.

The colorful square at the bottom will indicate the BPM of the track, so you’ll have an idea of what it’ll be like to use in game.

When you’re done creating your custom cassette, you can also export it and share it with your friends, Robobeat community members, your followers, your pets, or even that one guy you met at the bus stop, so they can play using it too!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250025/0fa1ef38fb15ec29f0fb9760ea145504b47fa8dd.gif[/img]

Once you’re back in the game, all you need to do is switch to your new custom cassette and shoot robots to the beat of your own drum. 

It’s really as simple as that!

You’ll also be able to effortlessly shift between any of the songs you’ve discovered or added to your cassette library, so you’ll never have to go back to the main menu or exit the game again. EVER.

With the help of IGN, we revealed our in-game custom music feature. Check out our exclusive full reveal below 👇

notes.title: Get Access to Our Exclusive Demo
notes.notes:
[h3]Have you been staring longingly at our gameplay footage? Do you yearn for the chance to give the beat down to some psychedelic robots?[/h3]

[h3]Then we’ve got good news! Your suffering is nearly over…[/h3]


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1456760/ROBOBEAT/

[h3]We’ve made a demo of Robobeat, but it’s super secret.[/h3]

To get access to this demo, you’ll need to join our Discord, head to the “request-demo-code” channel, and then ask for a code. Soon, glorious techno-angels will descend and bestow a code unto you. By which we mean, someone from our team will DM you with a code, so you can start your journey as a robo-gunslinger 🤖

[url=https://bit.ly/RobobeatDiscord3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41250025/2e8b24967cb80f10d6fa30f468b332a6c5987803.png[/img][/url]

[h3]Want to know a bit more about our demo before you dive in?[/h3]

Feel free to ask any questions in our community forum or in our Discord, but we’ve also prepared a short FAQ here to let you know what to expect.

[b]What’s included in the demo?[/b]

Officially speaking, our demo includes 9 weapons, 6 special abilities, and 4 songs for you to try out. Unofficially speaking, we may have hidden some extra stuff in there for you to find, so keep your eyes peeled at all times 👀

[b]What should I do if I find a bug?[/b]

We’re hoping you don’t encounter any bugs but, if you do, we’d really appreciate your help so we can squash them!

All you need to do is use the bug reporting feature within the demo itself and fill out a bug report. That way, we’ll automatically receive the log file, which will give us invaluable information on how to target and eliminate that nasty bug. 

[b]Where can I post my suggestions and feedback?[/b]

We’d love to hear all of the feedback you have to share, good or bad!

You can either post your feedback in our Steam community forum or in the “suggestion-box” channel of our Discord. 

[b]Can I stream or create content with the demo?[/b]

Of course! If you do stream or make content using the demo, remember to tag us on social media at @robobeatgame and we’ll try to share as much as possible. You’re also welcome to share your Robobeat content in our Discord.

We hope you enjoy our first demo and we can’t wait to see what awesome trick shots you have to share with us 🎵
